minor.title: Efficient Design
content: * Best for defensive play.
* When using Efficient Design, always wait to take a bit of damage before deploying her barrier.

minor.title: Extended Power
content: * Better for offense.
* Extending your primary fire by 5m is very powerful; do not underestimate the strength of this minor perk.

* After activating, experiment with the increased range. Keep rotating during fights, and abuse your superior range when battling ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tanks.

* Ignore the enemy ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank and use your Beam to Target squishy targets who think they are safe.

major.title: Disruptive Detonation
content: * Aim to detonate ![](/data/assets/guide/a4c29a25893817ef.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcrystal-charge.png)Crystal Charge between two enemies to maximize the perk’s CC effect.

* Slow down the enemy ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank's approach, and hinder enemies trying to escape.
* Recommended Major Perk

major.title: Power Move
content: * Good to give ![](/data/assets/guide/91e2ca432368c785.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdomina.png)Domina counterplay against melee heroes.

* Once the enemy is in melee range, first deploy barrier behind them, then use ![](/data/assets/guide/2a769fd04e1536dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsonic-repulsors.png)Sonic Repulsors to wall slam them into your barrier.
* Power Move only causes barrier to act as a wall for Sonic wall slams. Enemies can still freely walk and move through it as usual.

minor.title: Spotter
content: * Extremely powerful for enabling your allies. Healing and granting a speed boost can turn your teammates into carries.

minor.title: Jump-Ups
content: * Best on maps with lots of high ground. ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya normally struggles on these maps, but the extra jump height gives her more mobility options.

major.title: Energy Lance
content: * Best against brawly comps that play grouped up. Target the enemies behind and rotate to keep the front-most enemy in the beams path.

major.title: Extra Oomph
content: * Stops decay, and builds more overall energy than just taking damage. Great when the enemy team is smart and trying not to charge you up.

minor.title: Kinetic Cycle
content: * Decent when struggling to maintain distance for dive and brawl ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tanks. Otherwise, take the other.

minor.title: Hyper Regeneration
content: * Barrier health is very important, and ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma deals a lot of damage from his primary fire. Your team gains a significant amount of increased shielding, and in turn, everyone has an easier time staying alive.

major.title: Hyper Strike
content: * Interesting ability that is pretty good at countering any enemy with a primarily close-ranged kit. Send them floating and out of their optimal range.

major.title: Levitation
content: * Very good as it gives ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma the one thing he is missing, mobility.
* Best use is to traverse between high ground areas where your poke pressure can dominate.

minor.title: Chronal Dash
content: * Increased movement, and can be good for chasing enemies with high mobillity.
* The main problem is that you would have to adjust muscle memory of blink distance mid-round.
* Not worth taking over Kinetic Reload.

minor.title: Kinetic Reload
content: * Recommended Minor Perk
* Incredibly strong Perk to help secure elims. You literally restore 50% of your ammo with each Melee.
* Blink > Melee when you need just a few more bullets for the kill, as quick melee is faster than reloading.

major.title: Blink Packs
content: * Considering ![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)Tracer uses frequently grabs health packs, this will help you get back into the fight a bit faster, multiple times per game.
* Great when dueling and are able to grab a health pack. Tracer puts herself in a lot of 1v1 scenarios. Health packs restoring a Blink give her increased survivability.
* * Also, she can now steal health packs from the enemy **even when she’s at full health**. Don’t let them grab it!

major.title: Quantum Entanglement
content: * Helpful for confirming elims
* * Sometimes, enemies survive with a bit of health. Overhealth and extra ammo come in handy to help stay in the fight after Recalling to get that final blow.
* Should probably still disengage
* * Even with the overhealth, if you have no Blinks available, you should still get out of the fight and wait for your cooldowns to refresh.

* In General, don't go aggro after using ![](/data/assets/guide/59884f41423190cf.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frecall.png)Recall.

minor.title: Raging Storm
content: no guide provided
perk: Raging Storm

minor.title: Extra Edge
content: * The best tip for Extra Edge is to not use it.
* In theory, you can get an extra projectile in before recharging, but this is very low impact.

major.title: Relentless
content: * Taking Relentless increases the Onslaught passive buffs from 25% attack speed up to 40%, and from 20% movement speed up to 32%.
* Incredibly strong when combined with Sihponning Strike, since you’ll be able to stay swinging for longer.
* Coordinate with your team because a pocketed Vendetta with full Relentless buff will feel unstoppable to the enemy team.
* Recommended Major perk

major.title: Siphoning Strike
content: no guide provided
perk: Siphoning Strike

minor.title: Deceleration Field
content: **Extended Mag**
* Weaker Minor Perk
* Build more charge
* * The one benefit of taking Extended Mag is that you can theoretically build charge shots faster because of the decrease in time spent reloading.

minor.title: Overcharged
content: * Best Minor Perk
* One-shot 250 HP heroes
* * A 150% charged shot deals 255 damage on a critical hit. Since the majority of the roster falls within this threshold, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to delete heads.
* Primary fire between shots
* * Don’t forget to spam primary fire to generate charge faster and get off as many secondary fire shots as possible during your ult’s duration.

major.title: Dual Thrusters
content: * Best Major Perk
* * Yes, you sacrifice a bit of vertical height, but getting a 2nd charge of Power Slide is incredibly powerful.
* New movement options

* * Normally, we urge great caution when engaging with Power Slide. With Dual Thrusters, however, you are free to go in deep with your first Slide, since you retain the option of disengaing with the second slide.
* Good for anti-dive
* * Being able to double slide raises Sojourn’s survivability by making her more difficult to catch and kill.
* The window of vulnerability where she has no slide is effectively cut in half, and harder for the enemy to track.
**Adhesive Siphon**
* Weaker Major Perk
* Damage is cut in half
* * Adhesive Disruptor only deals about 150 damage maximum. Even if you stick a target, you’ll also need to land a lot of extra damage if you want to elim.
* Rail and ult charge
* * The ability to stick Disruptor to an enemy boosts its consistency in dealing damage. Plus if the stuck target is close to other enemies, you get the AoE damage as well.
* Consequently, you’ll be generating both Rail and ult charge faster.
* A stuck target generates 36 energy for Railgun.
* Wait for an easy target
* * 15-second cooldowns need to be used carefully. Wait until you see an easy shot before haphazardly blasting away.

major.title: Friction Generators
content: no guide provided
perk: Friction Generators

minor.title: Urgent Care
content: _“Healing Ofuda projectile speed is increased by 50% when seeking critical health allies.”_
* Take if you’ve already noticed your team demanding a lot of healing.
* * Receiving healing sooner when at critical health can mean the difference between life or death for your ally. The farther they are from you, the greater benefit the Perk gives.

minor.title: Fortune Teller
content: _“Kunai hits launch 2 Healing Ofuda to an ally in front of you.”_
* Free healing when attacking
* * If you are able to be aggressive and attack frequently, Fortune Teller is the better Perk to take.

* With the Fortune teller perk, it's worth shooting two Kunai between every ![](/data/assets/guide/b83666fe6c7d4451.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-ofuda.png)Healing Ofuda. For a slight delay in primary fire, she has the chance to deal damage and increase healing potential from the extra 2 Ofudas per hit.

major.title: Ready Step
content: _“Swift Step grants Kiriko 40% increased attack and reload speed for 3 seconds."_
* When selecting Ready Step, your dives become more lethal. Wait to TP to your ally until they need assistance with an elimination.

* Be smart. Just because you get buffed offense, doesn't mean you should always TP aggressively. ![](/data/assets/guide/ac12e57db5e0a620.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fswift-step.png)Swift Step is you best escape tool, so if you TP into multiple enemies, you likely won't escape.

major.title: Foxtrot
content: _“Protection Suzu grants 30% movement speed to allies for 4 seconds.”_
* 30% movement speed is really strong, especially on heroes who need to stay close to deal optimal damage.

* * For example, when playing with ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)Reinhardt the movement speed allows him to chase down squishies that would otherwise be just barely outside his range.

* Better disengage. Faster movement speed enables you and your allies to escape more effectively when using![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu defensively.

minor.title: Soundwave Rider
content: **Bass Blowout**
* Higher Value Minor Perk
* * Lucio can benefit from Bass Blowout every four seconds.
* Against dive, brawl, and rush comps, 100% take Bass Blowout as the extra knockback distance will keep you and your team safer.
* Easier environmental kills
* * On maps with lots of ledges, Bass Blowout makes knocking people off the map even more consistent.

minor.title: Beat Drop
content: * Stack Amp it Up uses

* * Use Amp it up before ![](/data/assets/guide/d2ebbaa1842e11ad.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsound-barrier.png)Sound Barrier to maximize your benefit of Beat Drop.
* Amp it up lasts 6 seconds, and Amp it Up’s cooldown is 12 seconds. At most, you’ll only have to wait 6 seconds before another Amp it Up is available.

major.title: Noise Violation
content: * Good in teams that are more spread out. If your team is running a lot of poke heroes like ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana, ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe, and ![](/data/assets/guide/9d5aac4b0dd47287.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ffreja.png)Freja, you’ll be more likely to get them all in your AoE with Noise Violation.
* Lucio’s playstyle and positioning caters to allies who need speed boost the most already, so the extra Amp range isn’t really necessary.

major.title: Accelerando
content: * Better for aggressive Lucio players
* * When you solo or team speed into the enemy team, 50% attack speed can be the difference between getting an elim or your target surviving long enough to kill you.
* If you try for a lot of aggressive plays, or dive the enemy DPS and Supports, you should be running Accelerando.

minor.title: Rapid Construction
content: * Increase Pylon Uptime

* * As previously stated, the biggest weakness of ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari and her ![](/data/assets/guide/2b591a0928bd1b4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon is how much downtime there is between uses. The CD reduction has a more notable effect when replacing the Pylon without taking damage, but it's always helpful.
* Better at saving allies

* * The faster construction time allows ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari to deploy ![](/data/assets/guide/2b591a0928bd1b4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon near an ally in danger and begin granting healing significantly faster. Against dive comps, Rapid Construction is the better Minor Perk.

minor.title: Summer Solstice
content: * Makes outplaying your ult more difficult
* * The extra flight time and speed make it harder for the enemy to avoid your ult and makes your fire timing more unpredictable.
* Against comps with a lot of Captive Sun Counters, you should take Summer Solstice.

major.title: Solar Flare
content: * Great for adding burst and AoE healing to ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari's kit, which is one of her main weaknesses for sustain.
* It can be activated as long as the energy resource is not completely depleted.
* Recommended Perk, unless the enemy team is hard-focusing you on dives.

major.title: Sunburn
content: * Anti-dive

* * The main strength of Outburst is the distance it creates between ![](/data/assets/guide/2975ce75297a0957.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fillari.png)Illari and her attackers. The extra damage over time will help her win 1v1 duels.

* Most effective when you are being sustained by ![](/data/assets/guide/2b591a0928bd1b4f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhealing-pylon.png)Healing Pylon because the burning damage is only ~23 damage /second, so you'll need to stay alive long enough to benefit.

minor.title: Bunny Power
content: * Safer Minor Perk

* * The extra health makes it way easier to survive long enough to remech. Enemies look to instantly kill pilot ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va when she ejects from her mech. Bunny Power helps her to tank those attacks.

minor.title: Extended Boosters
content: * Good for diving
* * When diving the enemy backline, you can Boosters through their Tank and any other enemies in the path to proc Extended Boosters.

* Chasing a ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy, for example, is much easier when you have more flight time.
* Numbers
* * Each boop deals 25 damage.
* Base Boosters have a 2-second duration. Hitting two enemies extends the duration by 50%.

major.title: Shield System
content: * Increased self-sustain

* * Shield health moves to the front of ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va’s health pool and is damaged first.
* Matrix converting damage absorbed to recover lost shield health increases your survivability mid-fight.

major.title: Precision Fusion
content: * Best when you want to focus on offensive power and kill potential.
* Save for finishing blows instead of using it at the start of attacks.

minor.title: Electric Charge
content: * Excellent for chasing opponents as they try get away from your dives.
* Compared to Heavy Landing, this perk will give you more consistent value.

* Best when the enemy has speed boosting abilities or if you are not confident with ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)Primal Rage juggling.

minor.title: Heavy Landing
content: * Best Minor Perk

* Increased lethality during ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)Primal Rage

* * Every time you ![](/data/assets/guide/71e72edd3dddab12.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjump-pack.png)Jump Pack during ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)Primal Rage, you’ll deal more burst damage. The extra damage is surprisingly helpful in converting kills.
* The longer you’re in the air, the higher the resource meter fills up, and you’ll deal more damage upon landing.
* In general, it’s better to only go for a high Jump on the initial attack, then keep the Jumps low and quick.

major.title: Chain Lightning
content: * Extra ult charge

* * Chain lightning deals an extra 72 damage when hitting 2 extra enemies. Compared to the 48 damage of a single hit, ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)Winston can generate 2.5x the amount of ult charge with every secondary fire.
* Potential for final blows
* * The bounce can hit enemies behind cover as long as they have a targetable teammate in range. You may be able to get some final blows if the enemy is one-shot.

major.title: Revitalizing Barrier
content: * Self healing
* * Even a few seconds of healing while bubble dancing with an enemy can make the difference between winning the exchange and getting out alive.
* Extra ult charge

* * A full duration Barrier heals 240 HP to each hero inside. The healing you and your allies receive generates ult charge. When needing to farm ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)Primal Rage for a fight, you can use the bubble defensively and heal your allies.

minor.title: Scrap Hook
content: * Save yourself from embarrassment

* * The worst feeling every ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog player has experienced is Hooking an enemy and finding you have no ammo, so you just stand there reloading with the enemy in your face.
* Scrap Hook guarantees you’ll always have the ammo necessary for your Hook combos.
* Increase shotgun uptime

* * The extra 2 ammo effectively decreases the time ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog spends reloading by 30%

minor.title: Shrapnel Launcher
content: * The new range is about 15m for the explosion range, which actually makes you weaker in the 10-14m range than without the perk. Keep this in mind to help you make your choice.
* Great when you are confident in your aim. Opens up way more ranged damage during the poke phases of fights.
* Especially good on maps with longer sightlines, such as Colosseo.

major.title: Invigorate
content: * Better for flank and solo playstyle. Can flank and reposition to and from off-angles more quickly.

* Good for disengaging as well. When you need to run away from something like ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)Ramattra's Ult, Invigorate makes it possible.

major.title: Pulled Pork
content: * The extra sustain is very strong. Take Pulled Pork when the enemy team has been laying a lot of damage on you. You’ll be able to stay in fights longer and position more forward.

minor.title: Suppressive Security
content: * Makes Emre’s Ult more lethal by making it easier to land follow-up Heavy shots.
* * Slow the enemy with light rounds, then finish them off with a heavy round.
* Enemies will be more hesitant to challenge your ult, thus making ulting a bit safer.

minor.title: Enhanced Agility
content: * Decent for escaping and evading while Siphon Blaster cools off.
* Since the blaster is constantly overheating (without Heat Sink), you can take advantage of moments when you need to let it cool off.
* The 20% increase in movement speed, on top of the base movement buff, makes escaping feel more realistic.

major.title: Heat Sink
content: * Recommended Major Perk
* Fire more shots for more total time. Also results in greater life steal. If you are confident in aiming Siphon Blaster, this is a great Perk. Allows you to play more aggressively.
* Especially good for dueling, and for when Tanks are pressuring you (easier to land more shots on their large bodies).

major.title: Cyber Adhesion
content: * Transforms Cyber Frag into a cyber semtex.
* Sneak up on an enemy, throw the nade to stick, and immediately ADS headshot. You’ll delete DPS and Supports.

minor.title: Remote Detonator
content: * Useful for exploding ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)Dynamite over walls and around corners where you can’t shoot it.

* Also, safer than standing in the open to shoot the ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)Dynamite.

minor.title: Double-Barreled
content: * Best against dive comps. You can create space between yourself and the enemy with the first shot, then you have another shot to reposition even better.

major.title: Viper's Sting
content: * Best poke Perk
* * The extra damage is very powerful on maps with long sight lines. The bonus damage is also not affected by falloff, so the extra 25 damage keeps its effectiveness at all ranges.

* Also useful for pressure ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tanks as landing two shots in a row is very easy on their large bodies.
* Bonus damage reset
* * The “consecutive scoped shots” reset after every hit, 2 scoped shots, when missing a scoped shot, or after 3 seconds of no shots.
* Hip fire shots do not affect Viper’s Sting’s counter.

major.title: Airburst
content: * Best anti-brawl Perk
* * When the enemy team plays as a deathball, the larger AoE will help you burn more targets with each use.

* Increase ![](/data/assets/guide/6d41bdb3da6b2de8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fthe-viper.png)The Viper uptime

* * Even if you don’t hit any targets with ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)Dynamite, every time ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe shoots it out of the air, she reloads 3 ammo. This helps her reduce reload time and increases the time she spends firing.

* Don’t pick against a ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)Kiriko

* * The increased AoE is essentially negated by ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)Protection Suzu. Remember Suzu heals extra when cleansing effects like Burning, so you’ll be feeding her a lot of Ult charge.

minor.title: Focused Rush
content: * Recommended Minor Perk

* ![](/data/assets/guide/9ecb1957f6f092f0.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffocusing-beam.png)Focusing Beam is ![](/data/assets/guide/ec8f0896ca78ec6f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fecho.png)Echo's best ability, so buffing it is very strong for her. The increased range and speed enable you to position more safely and target enemies normally out of your range.

minor.title: Partial Scan
content: * Install ults

* * A good use of starting with 50% ult charge is for copying heroes with install ultimates like ![](/data/assets/guide/f9410941588ff5c9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprimal-rage.png)Primal Rage, ![](/data/assets/guide/de397de5fd8f936e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fannihilation.png)Annihilation, ![](/data/assets/guide/7b9aee18b1847b4b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdragonblade.png)Dragonblade, ![](/data/assets/guide/74549b59ef18f026.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Foverclock.png)Overclock, etc.
* Many times, you’ll find that without Partial Scan, by the time you generate the copied ult, your time runs out and cancels the ult.
* Prioritize earning ult
* * Partial Scan should be treated as a time extension as soon as you activate copy. Take some extra time to play safe, stay alive, and farm your copy's ult.
* Dying (copy ending) before getting ult completely wastes this Minor Perk selection.

major.title: Full Salvo
content: * Best Major Perk
* * Echo can benefit from Full Salvo every 6 seconds as compared to only benefitting from High Beams when specifically getting elims from Beam after using Flight.
* Extra burst damage
* * The math works out to roughly 30% more damage compared to regular Sticky Bombs.
* Full Salvo is more consistent at getting all DPS below half health for Focusing Beam combos (even those with high health and armor).

major.title: High Beams
content: * Full aggro beam usage
* * Being able to use Flight twice in a row enables some crazy aggressive plays. You can Flight dive the backline, kill, fly to cover, wait for Beam, and assassinate another.
* Hard to rely on the reset

* * To fully benefit from the Flight reset, you’ll want to fly in deep, secure an elim with Beam, then fly away. However, if the enemy survives your beam, you are left with no cooldowns and a death sentence.
* You should be used to Flight management and not leaving yourself exposed after Focusing Beam use. Therefore, you’ll have to adjust your playstyle to benefit from the Flight reset.

minor.title: Bang Bang
content: * New breakpoints
* * Landing both Flashbangs creates new instakill combos for Cassidy
* * Bang Bang + headshot = 230 Dmg (225HP hero one-shot)
* Best for anti-dive
* * Extra damage and range make Bang Bang the superior choice against enemy DPS and Support flankers.

minor.title: Even the Odds
content: * Tank damage over time
* * In standard 5v5 games, Cassidy can generate up to 150 HP of self-healing every second. Even if there are only a couple of targets, the extra healing helps to survive against non-burst damage
* If the enemy is running Moira / Juno, for example, neither of them can burst or stun Cassidy, and he’s very likely to survive channeling Deadeye with the extra healing.
* When to avoid picking
* * If the enemy has easy ways of stopping Deadeye with stuns like Sleep Dart, or burst damage like Widow Maker, then the healing is not helpful.

major.title: Rollin' Round-Ups
content: Rollin' Round-Up
* As you should normally be using Roll to reload a full clip, you will naturally get a lot of sustain value from this perk.

major.title: Silver Bullet
content: * Swap out the close-range burst for more min-range lethality.
* * Silver Bullet crit + plus primary fire body shot will kill 275 HP heroes
* The burst damage is quite good, but you have to sacrifice Fan the Hammer and the sustain Rollin' Round-Up would give you.
* Two Silver Bullet body shots will eliminate 275 HP heroes if the shots are spaced out.
* * Bleed does not stack. You'll need to wait between Silver Bullet shots if you want to maximize damage over time.

minor.title: Sentry Capacity
content: * Patrol and extra flank angle

* * Sentry Capacity is useful to select when the enemy has been flanking you and giving you trouble. You can place one turret on both sides of you, and still have two more to use as you normally would to attack the enemies in front of you.
* More choke pressure

* * Make a semi-circle around the main choke and watch the enemy team get blasted from every angle. Although they can still destroy them, it takes more time and they’ll have suffered more damage in the process.
**Advanced Teleportation**
* Best Minor Perk
* Why you want the extra TP distance
* * Sym doesn’t have to get so close to her desired TP location, which means her deploy positioning is safer.
* When bypassing choke points, you can get your team farther behind the enemy, which often results in a more advantageous position.
* Better escapes
* * When using TP to disengage, you create even more distance between you and your attackers which gives you a higher chance of surviving.
* Dive deep into the backline
* * When the enemy team has a Sniper sitting way in the back who isn’t dying, TP all the way back to them and take them out.

minor.title: Perfect Alignment
content: * Max range
* * At level 3 your beam will gain 3.6 extra meters of range for a total of 15.6 meters.
* Counter brawl and rush
* * Against close range and melee enemies, Perfect Alignment will help you outrange them and be able to attack while taking less damage.
* Paired with a speed boost like Lucio or Juno’s Hyper Ring, Perfect Alignment is even stronger because you can get in close to level up your beam, then back up with the extra range.

perk: Hovering Barrier

major.title: Shield Battery
content: * Best for duels and flanks
* * If you find yourself spending more time flanking and 1v1ing the enemy than you do on the frontline, then Shield Battery is the better Major Perk for you.
* Receiving constant self-healing comes in clutch to win more duels and flank more aggressively.
* The tether visually indicates you’re in range and receiving healing.
* Refer to _“Tips for Teleporter”_ for a breakdown of offensive strategies to employ with TP.

perk: Helix Propulsion

major.title: Agility Training
content: * When matched up against multiple dive enemies, Agility Training can be the better Major Perk to select. Escaping faster and not having to stop to reload increases uptime without sacrificing evasive maneuvers.
* If Biotic Field is deployed, Sprint around inside it while reloading to keep dodging and healing until reloading has finished.

major.title: Stim Pack
content: * Heal or boost

* * Since you don’t lose the option to use Biotic Field for healing if needed, Stim Pack allows for some versatility. Turn Soldier into a glass cannon as he gains attack speed at the cost of being anti-healed.
* The short 4-second window means you’ll want to know and see your target before activating Stim Pack, or else you risk wasting the long CD.
* Cleanse effects

* * Abilities like Protection Suzu, Projected Barrier, and Life Grip will cleanse the anti-heal effect. This is especially good when using Stim Pack for Tac Visor, as the enemy team will likely all turn and focus you.

minor.title: Swift Cuts
content: **Acrobatics**
* Not very useful
* * Compared to Dragon’s Thirst, Acrobatics brings very little value to Genji. You’re rarely going to find a use for being able to double jump, dash, then double jump again.

minor.title: Dragon's Thirst
content: * Best Minor Perk
* * Lifesteal during Dragonblade enables you to be even more aggressive than normal during your ult.
* Less reliant on team resources
* * When running Dragon’s Thirst, Genji has more agency to make big plays without the need for healing or comboing with ults like Nano Boost.
* When swinging repeatedly, Genji gains up to ~45 healing per second, and with Nano, it jumps up to ~70 healing per second!
* Still not invincible
* * Always remember that just because you are lifestealing, you aren’t invincible, so take your standard precautions and don’t try to 1v5 the enemy team.

major.title: Blade Twisting
content: * More damage, ult charge, and elims

* * More damage is more good. But, you'll need to use ![](/data/assets/guide/2b083b4a4d737525.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fswift-strike.png)Swift Strike late in your combos to ensure you get the bonus damage.

* Against the 175 HP heroes ![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)Tracer and pilot ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va, the extra 25 damage makes ![](/data/assets/guide/2b083b4a4d737525.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fswift-strike.png)Swift Strike > ![](/data/assets/guide/7b9aee18b1847b4b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdragonblade.png)Dragonblade slash kill.

major.title: Meditation
content: * Significantly increase survivability
* * Restore up to 70 health during Deflect. The extra health enables Genji to stay in fights longer, and thereby deal more damage.
* Help with beams
* * While 35 healing per second is lower than the damage per second of every beam, it will still help Genji to survive some situations where he would’ve otherwise died.

minor.title: Groggy
content: * Best against dive
* * Ana is always a dive priority target, so anything that helps her counter their attacks is huge for her viability.
* The extra damage and slow debuff is basically a guaranteed kill against any hero without an invincible escape tool.
* Shutdown enemy ults
* * Sleep is already one of the best ability counters to ults in Overwatch, but the added slow can give your team the extra space they need to avoid the enemy ult after they awake.
* Ex: Ram ulting at your team, Ana Sleeps him, and by the time he wakes up, then slow walks, your team can get out of his AoE and end his ult early.

minor.title: Speed Serum
content: * Best when aggressive Nano targets like Reinhardt who struggle to chase down retreating enemies.
* If you absolutely need to, you can Nano the nearest or easiest target just to give yourself the speed boost if you will die otherwise.

major.title: Headhunter
content: * Just to flex
* * Refer to the _“Tips for Biotic Rifle”_ section, and you’ll see ADS shots against enemies have a significantly decreased bullet size. This makes landing headshots with Ana quite difficult.
* Additionally, the multiplier is only 1.5x, so the return isn’t that great.

* Head hurtboxes are mostly hidden when looking at the backs of heroes, and you’ll essentially always be looking at the backs of your teammates. Consequently, critical hits on allies are also impractical.

major.title: Biotic Bounce
content: * Win button
* * Although the damage and healing are reduced on the 2nd bounce, the anti and heal buffs are the same.
* Potentially, Ana can hit the enemy frontline with the first bounce, then mid or back enemies with the second bounce. Anti-healing on a majority of the enemy team
* Hitting a nade into a wall next to or behind a target is also a very effective means of hitting tricky angles.

minor.title: Ulterior Motive
content: * Refills fuel even during ![](/data/assets/guide/5232ea25e34d2656.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffrenetic-flight.png)Frenetic Flight.
* Significantly increases mobility and flight uptime when you are healing.
* Dealing Damage does not convert into fuel.
* Recommended default Minor Perk

minor.title: Transport Shielding
content: * Best for strategic play-making. Allows you to take more damage while transporting an ally for a flank play. Also makes it safer to go for environmental KOs after your Ult.
* Recommended when playing with comms or frequently coordinating transport plays.

major.title: Headbutt
content: * Need to have almost half fuel and to travel ~8m to build enough momentum for the boop. (Displayed as VFX circling your screen)
* Works in transport mode
* Pair with Ulterior Motive for more frequent use.

major.title: Claws Out
content: * Best for consistent aggressive plays. If your team is using an aggressive closerange strategy such as brawl, rush or dive, having extra damage every 6-seconds on your melee is quite powerful.
* When your team is playing more distance or poke styles, you won’t have many opportunities to use Claws Out.
* Recommended Major Perk

minor.title: Wellspring
content: * Helps keep your AoE healing higher and get it up sooner in fights.
* Good when your other Support lacks AoE healing.

minor.title: Exposed Soul
content: * Considering enemies tethered by ![](/data/assets/guide/61a533467bf9f01d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbinding-chain.png)Binding Chain can still attack you, it’s important to eliminate them as quickly as possible. Exposed Soul helps turn every successful chain into a KO.
* Best for duels and countering enemy dives.

major.title: Resonant Return
content: * To mazimize benefit of the extra bounce, try to use Healing Kasa when your team is positioned closely together.
* Good for increasing defensive capabilities.
* Best when you need to serve as the main source of your team’s sustain.

major.title: Quickstep
content: * Best for rush and dive comps, as it enables a hyper-aggressive team initiation.
* Similar to Lucio’s speed aura, communicating with your team via VC, ping, or a voice line like “3-2-1” is important for coordinating ability timings.
* * The speedboost window is short, so your team will get more benefit if they are prepared, instead of having to react once they realize the speed aura is active.

minor.title: Overflow
content: * Grants the ability to give more burst healing to your allies, and less offensive downtime for yourself due to less time spent reloading.
* Recommended Minor Perk

minor.title: Balance
content: * Allows you to focus even more on dealing damage. As long as you keep hitting enemies, your selected ally will keep benefitting from increased healing.

major.title: Ebb and Flow
content: * Not a terrible perk, but not worth taking over Falling Rain.
* May help with countering dive comps by improving your close-range capabilities.
* Try it out if you have been unable to get value out of your charged primary fire up to this point.

major.title: Falling Rain
content: * Very powerful for increasing total and burst damage.
* As soon as you unlock the Major Perk, you should start putting more emphasis on dealing damage.

* All the same tips from ![](/data/assets/guide/8fbe92ce7f53c900.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fxuanwu-staff.png)Xuanwu Staff apply as the use case does not change.

minor.title: Deep Leap
content: * Counter high mobility

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard can have difficulty keeping up with targets who have lots of mobility, like ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno, ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy, and ![](/data/assets/guide/0df66e1c25a77a79.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsojourn.png)Sojourn. The extra Leap distance helps him to close the gap and stay in a more advantageous range for him.
* Faster engages
* * With the increased distance, you won’t have to break up your approach into as many stages since you can dive from farther away.
* More often, you’ll be able to bypass the enemy frontline and instantly reach the backline with Leap.
* Pairs with Off The Top
* * You can go all in on Leap perks and structure your game plan around Leap and Slash. Just know you’ll be sacrificing Lifesteal and Wall uptime to do so.

minor.title: Anarchic Zeal
content: * Self healing

* * A full-duration ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)Spike Guard with Anarchic Zeal will heal you for approximately 50 HP per target.
