* Run with Reconstitution
* * When planning to use Anarchic Zeal, you should select Reconstitution as your Minor Perk to capitalize on the Lifesteal.

* ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard can trap an enemy in a corner between his body and ![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall while holding ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)Spike Guard.

* Every couple of seconds, they’ll retrigger ![](/data/assets/guide/860a1f6211acadb3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjagged-wall.png)Jagged Wall and Reconstitution's energy refill. Enjoy watching them panic as you slowly drain their life.

major.title: Reconstitution
content: * Significantly increased uptime

* * Upon reading the Perk description, you may think it sounds weak. What makes Reconstitution powerful, however, is that ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard uses the base ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)Spike Guard resource before depleting the overfill. Also, the overfill does not decay, so you can hold onto it as long as needed.

* Between the instant refill and overfill, you’ll be able to use ![](/data/assets/guide/c47191eac4c3da8b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fspike-guard.png)Spike Guard considerably more often or for longer uses.

major.title: Explosive Impalements
content: * Extra burst damage

* * Very good for securing elims with your team and solo kills. You don't have to do anything special because all ![](/data/assets/guide/8f2eb5a45467c702.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhazard.png)Hazard players should already be using the combo listed above of shoot > Leap > Melee. Basically, a free extra 40 damage.

minor.title: Crusader's Fire
content: * Guarantees you have a ![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)Fire Strike to follow up on ![](/data/assets/guide/7d8540657f6fd9b7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fearthshatter.png)Earthshatter.
* Standard 250 HP heroes can be killed by Shatter > Fire Strike(x2), so this perk makes your shatter's more consistently lethal.

minor.title: Crusader's Resolve
content: * Good in matchups where you are forced to play more passive such as when facing ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa or ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga.
* Also a decent choice if your Supports have lower healing output.

major.title: Shield Slam
content: * Lose the ability to hold secondary fire down and look around without rotating.
* The slam itself is ok, but generally not worth taking over the increased attack speed.

major.title: Ignited Fury
content: * Save at least one ![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)Fire Strike for when you get into melee range. The increased attack speed is very strong in brawls and will help you win the ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank fight.

minor.title: Rampant Charge
content: * All in on your ultimate compared to Battle Shout bringing lower, but more frequent value.

* Make sure to use all your CDs before activating ![](/data/assets/guide/a110bdbe1bbd0f0f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frampage.png)Rampage.
* You can play hyper aggressive when you have ult because you'll be able to chain two ability cycles together.

minor.title: Battle Shout
content: “_Commanding Shout fully reloads Scattergun and increases allied reload speed by 50%.”_
* Extra aggression
* * Battle Shout empowers JQ and all allies in Shout AoE to be more aggressive thanks to the decrease in reload time.
* Reload speed buff
* * Reloading after 5 shots ensures you start reloading before Shout ends and lets you benefit from the 50% increased reload speed.

major.title: Willy-Willy
content: * Land easier Blade direct impacts, and get an bit of extra burst damage to help secure elims.

* Decent, but only take if you are getting hard CC'd everytime you try to ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)Carnage and need more ranged presence.

major.title: Savage Satiation
content: _“Carnage's impact damage gains 100% lifesteal.”_
* Recommended Major Perk
* Extra healing
* * Each enemy hit with her axe gives 105 HP healing. Multiply by the number of enemies hit, plus consider that each enemy hit also reduces the 8-second cooldown by 2 seconds.
* JQ becomes insanely more tanky when running Savage Satiation.

* If you hit just two enemies with an axe swing, JQ gets 390 total healing (Impact lifesteal plus Wound), and gets to use ![](/data/assets/guide/bb798f5782fe4ccc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcarnage.png)Carnage again 4 seconds later.

minor.title: Kinetic Bandolier
content: * Niche

* * In most scenarios where you’ve run out of ammo, you’ll also have used ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive and won’t have enough health to charge straight into the enemy to keep attacking.
* Plus, in these cases, you also won’t be running the full distance and therefore won’t get the max 150 ammo reloaded.
* Less downtime

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga's reload animation is much longer than most, so cutting down reload time is beneficial.
* Useful into poke and dive comps where you spend more time poking, then suddenly need to rush in.

minor.title: Pyromaniac
content: * Adds a small burst of instant overhealth whenever you ignite an enemy. Good for survivability, and best when having to play more passively.

major.title: Firewalker
content: * Best Major Perk

* * Ignited enemies take 15 damage per second, and can immediately be auto-crit by Cha-Cha. Since ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga is unstoppable during Overrun, he can easily ignite multiple enemies with each use.
* Burst damage

* * Slam onto an enemy, and they're instantly ignited. If you center slam their head, you’ll even get healing from the slam's critical hit. Plus, you’ll be dealing damage faster because you don’t have to spend time igniting them with primary fire before getting in the auto-crits.

major.title: Combat Fuel
content: * Don’t need the extra Overhealth

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga heals himself and reduces so much damage that you won’t even notice 100 extra Overhealth during Overdrive.
* Plus, you need to land 50 critical hits in between each use? Realistically, you’ll probably be averaging 50-60 overhealth with each Cardiac use.
* Soft counter to anti-healing and damage mitigation

* * Where Combat Fuel can be useful is in matchups with anti-heal like ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana nade, or Tanks who can mitigate your entire Cardiac duration. The extra overhealth could theoretically keep you alive.
* Still recommend always selecting Firewalker.

minor.title: Defense Protocol
content: * Makes ![](/data/assets/guide/135c836b3c9c24ac.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fterra-surge.png)Terra Surge an ok panic button. The healing will help you take more damage, and can save you when you are at low health.

minor.title: Mobile Fortification
content: * Very powerful and enables aggressive play when ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa is already at her most powerful. Feels unstoppable to the enemy team.

major.title: Charged Javelin
content: * Overall, the better Major Perk

* * In most scenarios, having to give up ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin is not worth the barrier. ![](/data/assets/guide/c56b764d48d7b25b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Forisa.png)Orisa is already very tanky, and ![](/data/assets/guide/6c968a00b8106f0d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fjavelin-spin.png)Javelin Spin blocks all projectiles for almost 2 seconds. Moreover, the speed boost during and after, plus the CC is stronger than having a shield.

major.title: Protective Barrier
content: * Match up dependent

* * Against ![](/data/assets/guide/e958e5cf8ba983fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmauga.png)Mauga, it could be considered the better Major Perk since it can be used to help counter ![](/data/assets/guide/b54c199ade517940.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcardiac-overdrive.png)Cardiac Overdrive.

* Against ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)Zarya, deploy a barrier anytime she uses bubble to block her damage and relieve the pressure of needing to break her barrier and charge her.

* In theory, you can use the Barrier to block ![](/data/assets/guide/3f791ccf8b419b4a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Framattra.png)Ramattra's ult LoS and try to end it early. The 600HP barrier may not survive long enough to rely on this tech, however.
* Double Barrier tip
* * When on defense or when the enemy team is returning from spawn, shoot the Barrier straight up. By the time it lands, you’ll only have 3 seconds before your next Barrier.

minor.title: One-Two
content: * Quick Punch

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist starts to auto reload while charging ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch, so One-Two makes the biggest difference on primary fire uses when not full charging ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch.

* Dump all ![](/data/assets/guide/91a2bc571e74c5b2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhand-cannon.png)Hand Cannon ammo into the enemy, quick ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch into a wall, finish them off with the refreshed primary fire, Slam away.

* Great with ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch

* * Because you don’t have to spend time charging Empowered ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch, One-Two gives you rapid burst damage potential.

minor.title: Survival of the Fittest
content: * A bit weaker overall than One-Two

* ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist gets plenty of elims

* * Because he has AoE abilities, and your team follows up on your engages, most kills by your team will have some damage assist from ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist and count as an elim for the extra overhealth.
* Not good if your team is getting rolled
* * On the occasion you need more solo play-making potential, One-Two would be better to take.
* When your team isn’t getting a lot of elims, you won’t get much benefit from choosing Survival of the Fittest

major.title: Aftershock
content: * The problem with Aftershock is that you have to give up Power Matrix. Only choose this perk if the enemy team has no projectile stuns.
* Engage with Slam so you get easy follow-up shots during the slow. Ideally, you'll already have an empowered punch so you can finish for an easy KO.

major.title: Power Matrix
content: * Best Major Perk
* Creates new counterplay

* * Previously, we stated ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist is particularly weak against stuns. Power Matrix gives him counterplay against stuns. As long as he times correctly, Power Matrix absorbs and negates all projectiles.
* Shares Defensive Matrix counters

* * Unfortunately, ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist is not totally invulnerable during ![](/data/assets/guide/1fda4cd48050e83c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpower-block.png)Power Block. Abilities like ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog Hook, ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch, and ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)Sigma's ![](/data/assets/guide/b87166103290a2c3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Faccretion.png)Accretion still counter Power Matrix.

minor.title: Smoulder
content: * Extends the time of burning.

* Does **not** extend ![](/data/assets/guide/99e4dd776d3d372b.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffan-the-flames.png)Fan the Flames amplified damage time.
* Useful for extending damage on enemies that retreat to cover. Will sometimes score an elim where the enemy could’ve just barely lived otherwise.
* Further delays the self-healing passive from activating.

minor.title: Heat Shield
content: * Turns ![](/data/assets/guide/6a979f3121204210.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvermillion-ascent.png)Vermillion Ascent into a survival tool. The large AoE makes it consistent and realistic to expect to hit multiple targets per use.
* Enables more aggressive use of your ult. Hitting 2 targets, for example, generates 150 overhealth.
* Use the overhealth generation mid-fight to as a form of healing, or at the start of an attack to make yourself more tanky.
* Recommended Minor Perk.

major.title: Short Fuse
content: * Rushing through multiple targets in a scrambly fight is a great way to spread burning, inflict damage, and evade damage.
* Hitting the same target twice counts as double cooldown reduction (3s total).
* Be smart about where you position yourself when the Rush ends. You’d have to get 6 impacts to fully refresh the Rush if you don’t have either charge up.

major.title: Hungering Blaze
content: * Extremely potent survival ability.

* Being in range of multiple enemies is even more important when using Hungering Blaze. As mentioned under Ability Tips, ![](/data/assets/guide/336ae88d165cfe5a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fanran.png)Anran will stay invulnerable for longer and additionally heal herself more.
* Recommended Major Perk.

minor.title: Configuration Reload
content: * Purposely use ![](/data/assets/guide/6ad6a85052cee304.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fa-36-tactical-grenade.png)A-36 Tactical Grenade before activating ![](/data/assets/guide/8d001c017ec66f5c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fconfiguration-assault.png)Configuration: Assault, and again before its duration ends.
* Grenade is really good for burst damage and for pressuring enemies hiding behind corners out of your LoS.
* This is generally the go-to Minor Perk, and Armored Artillery is more of a counter-pick.

minor.title: Armored Artillery
content: * Good against dive
* * When multiple heroes full dive you and you can’t run away, the overhealth can save your life and force the enemy to retreat.
* Activate ult and instantly drop one on your body and on your attackers. If allies are nearby, this should buy them enough time to peel for you.

major.title: Lindholm Explosives
content: * Even better for pressuring backlines

* * The splash damage forces ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)Supports not only to retreat, but also hide way behind cover where they won’t get hit by the splash damage. This extra space often allows your team to kill the other enemies that are not outside of their Support's LoS.
* Damage difference
* * Lower single-target damage per second output, in exchange for AoE damage.

major.title: Self-Repair
content: * Greatly increased survivability

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/9836801e140c9b2a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbastion.png)Bastion is already quite tanky and with Self-Repair, he feels impossible to kill for many heroes. Primarily use to heal yourself to help out your ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)Supports and get yourself back to full health quicker.
* Increase uptime
* * During Assault mode, the enemy will target you if they don’t run away. Alternate between healing and firing so you don’t have to fully disengage.
* Counter dive by pairing with Armored Artillery

* * Against full dive comps, running these two perks give ![](/data/assets/guide/9836801e140c9b2a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fbastion.png)Bastion the self-sustain required to survive dive attacks by multiple enemies simultaneously.

minor.title: Relentless Barrage
content: * Recommended Minor Perk

* Significantly increases spam uptime. If you hit multiple direct hits in a row using the standard combo listed under ![](/data/assets/guide/3e91f745133fcd75.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftake-aim-freja.png)Take Aim (Freja) tips (6 primary fire > 1 Take Aim > repeat), you would have infinite ammo and never stop to reload.

minor.title: Momentum Boost
content: * Good use is as a counter pick against dive and melee heroes. The extra dash distance can give you the space needed to evade their attacks.

* Activating ![](/data/assets/guide/3e91f745133fcd75.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftake-aim-freja.png)Take Aim (Freja) mid-air still freezes Freja, which minimizes the benefit of this Perk.

major.title: Aerial Recovery
content: * Recommended Minor Perk.

* Every time you jump and use ![](/data/assets/guide/af11f739171075dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fupdraft.png)Updraft + ![](/data/assets/guide/3e91f745133fcd75.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ftake-aim-freja.png)Take Aim (Freja) slow, you'll heal for over 75 HP. Even more when used off a ledge.

major.title: Rising Winds
content: * Considering the long cooldown of ![](/data/assets/guide/af11f739171075dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fupdraft.png)Updraft, doubling its uptime is a considerable buff.
* * Best when playing maps with walls to jump and shoot over.
* Also good as a counterpick against melee and very close-range heroes

minor.title: Sonic Disruption
content: * Useful for inconveniencing enemy flankers who rely on health packs to get back into the fight.
* If there is a flanker like Tracer, or a Tank like Wrecking Ball harassing your team, grabbing health packs and attacking you again, Sonic Disruption can be used to hinder their gameplay loop,.

minor.title: Dragon Fury
content: * Even if you only hit one out of every 3 shots, the increased draw speed is very strong for Hanzo.
* Take by default. Especially powerful when being pressured by Tanks.
* Recommended Minor Perk

major.title: Frost Arrow
content: * AoE effect, hitting a surface also triggers the explosion and will inflict slow on nearby enemies.
* Can be used during Storm Arrow, but not with Sonic Arrow.
* Try aiming at your target's feet to either get an easy body shot or floor explosion. Then, go for a headshot while they are slowed
* * Especially effective in combination with Dragon Furty.

major.title: Scatter Arrows
content: * In theory, you can get some cheeky KOs against retreating enemies inside rooms or around corners, but it’s too niche to be worth taking in any scenario over Frost Arrow.

minor.title: Mine Recycling
content: * Rewards efficient mine usage. Try to purposely save a Mine for landing the final blow.
* Very powerful and enables hyper-aggressive play. You can use one Mine to jump in, another to kill with the Frag-Mine combo, then a refreshed third to jump back out.
* Recommended Minor Perk

minor.title: Nitro Boost
content: * Makes it much more challenging for the enemy to predict Tire movement and destroy it.
* Particularly valuable on vertical or open maps.

major.title: Frag Cannon
content: * Increased projectile speed makes landing direct hits more consistent.
* Best on maps with longer sight lines, but never a bad choice.
* * The increased speed throws some players' muscle memory off, but most find the adjustment very helpful.
* Take it when you are focusing on long-range spam.

major.title: Bomb Voyage
content: * Makes your Mine jumps more lethal. Especially when paired with Mine Recycling and using the aforementioned three Mine jump-kill-jump method.
* Best used when playing flanks or surprising enemies by jumping over a wall and quickly raining Frags on them.
* Pick Bomb Voyage when you want to position more aggressively.

minor.title: Deep Burrow
content: * Good for flanks and increasing overall mobility.
* Enables more efficient engages and disengages.

minor.title: Excavation Exhilaration
content: * You dump all your cooldowns to get in and weaken enemies, pop ult, and quickly get them all back.
* The best part is you can burrow into Ult and then again to escape.

major.title: Smart Extender
content: * Really good to give yourself some poke potential.
* Best use is to finish off elims on targets who escape your range mid-fight.
* Though brief, it’s nice to have an option for better ranged damage.

major.title: Covered in Dirt
content: * Best for general flank and close-range combat playstyle that Venture primarily sticks to. Makes them more tanky during fights.

minor.title: Lingering Wraith
content: no guide provided
perk: Lingering Wraith

minor.title: Soul Reaving
content: * Extra tanky
* * Soul Globes are useful for making Reaper even more tanky with the added self-sustain. Allow him to stay in the fight a bit longer.
* Especially good in brawly fights on the objectives where enemies are dying in close range.
* Don’t try to pick up every Globe

* * Just because you see a Globe doesn’t mean you should pick it up. They can be bait and waste time for very little healing in return. Only pick them up when at critical health or when they are on the path to your targeted enemy.
Lingering Wraith
* Dangerous Perk

* * The speed boost encourages using ![](/data/assets/guide/7bf2a5a33fdf1bde.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwraith-form.png)Wraith Form to engage, but then you don't have it to escape. You need to be extremely confident you will get the elim, and still survive.
* Useful against mobile targets whose mobility lasts longer or moves them farther than your Wraith Form.

major.title: Dire Triggers
content: * Poke weapon
* * Greatly increased range damage and tightened bullet spread empower Reaper to finally be able to contribute to ranged fights.
* Before getting in close, start building ult charge, or pressuring the enemy team.
* Help with fliers

* * In matches with fliers like ![](/data/assets/guide/98529ba32956dcb8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fpharah.png)Pharah or ![](/data/assets/guide/ec8f0896ca78ec6f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fecho.png)Echo, Dire Triggers' longer range helps to pressure or even finish them off.
* Don’t give away your position on flanks

* * The damage from Dire Triggers isn’t worth beginning your flank attacks with. It’s still much better to get as close as possible, then attack with ![](/data/assets/guide/ee63221cfd675de0.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhellfire-shotguns.png)Hellfire Shotguns.

major.title: Shadow Blink
content: * Enables safer escape with ![](/data/assets/guide/e223d900c52de2b4.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fshadow-step.png)Shadow Step. The best use of the faster cast time is being able to get out of fights when you don't have ![](/data/assets/guide/7bf2a5a33fdf1bde.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwraith-form.png)Wraith Form.
* Recommended if you are using Lingering Wraith

minor.title: Skating Rink
content: * Adds a defensive benefit to your Ult.

* Even if half the enemy team is not frozen and can shoot you, you can wall them, heal up yourself and your team while eliminating the enemies that are frozen. Then you have an easy clean up against those left.

* Good for survivine damage over time and so you don't have to spend so much time in ![](/data/assets/guide/d3098a7cd908d5b1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcryo-freeze.png)Cryo-Freeze during your ult.

minor.title: Glacial Propulsion
content: * Best use is for taking and contesting high ground areas.
* Has a low maximum height, so you can't jump off high ground and activate it to get an extra boost.

* Especially good on high maps with a bit of high ground like King's Row and Blizzard World where ![](/data/assets/guide/83501cfadb6150e1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmei.png)Mei normally has a weakness against heroes with vertical mobility.

major.title: Deep Freeze
content: * Play close and hold corners
* * The ability to freeze enemies means you’ll want to spend as much time in primary fire range as possible. Position up front with your tank, or find enemies you can flank.
* When defending, stay at the choke and any corners. This forces close-range fights. Anyone who approaches you has to deal with the threat of being frozen, on top of getting walled off.
* Anti-Dive
* * Freezing any dive DPS is a death sentence for them. When the enemy team has mobility heroes giving you a hard time, shut them down with the Deep Freeze.

major.title: Cryo-Storm
content: * Big damage potential
* * Cryo-Storm deals 70 damage every second for up to 350 damage total.
* Try to trap an enemy in a corner or between Ice Wall and Cryo-storm.
* Block doorways
* * As noted in the Cryo-Freeze tips, blocking doorways is very strong for capturing and stalling objectives. Cryo-Storm adds damage as well, making the tactic even better!
* Ult charge
* * The extra damage Mei deals from Cryo-Storm adds up to a lot of extra ult generation over the course of a game. This is especially true when getting multiple enemies in your AoE.
* Blizzard combo
* * Similar to your primary fire, the slow effect of Cryo-Storm will speed up the freeze effect of Blizzard.
* The tech is OP since Mei’s invincible and slows enemies too fast for them to escape by walking out.

minor.title: Scoped Efficiency
content: * Less downtime thanks to less reloading.

minor.title: Sniper's Instinct
content: * Really good in Widow duels or when facing enemies that require you to use grapple to simultaneously evade and attack.

major.title: Widow’s Bite
content: no guide provided
perk: Widow’s Bite

major.title: Seeker Mine
content: * Patrols a much larger area than the standard mine. You’ll be alerted by the 10m radius and can leave it there without having to use the cooldown to redeploy.
**Widow's Bite**
* The charge rate is the same. Charging to 125% takes longer and decreases the rate of fire.
* Enables oneshots on all DPS, including Bastion and Torb.
* Also good if you’re spending more time shooting Tanks.
* The piercing helps on long flat areas a bit, but don’t waste your time fishing for collats.

minor.title: Hammer Time
content: **Craftsman**
* Niche Perk, but pairs ok with Overloaded Turret Major Perk
* * Extra healing for the Turret can be useful, but then you're also only going to benefit when babysitting your Turret. So this Perk is wasted when paired with Anchor Bolts, for example.
* Focus on holding one area and keeping your Turret healthy, even if you have to body block incoming damage.
* Don’t try to force armor healing
* * Torb shouldn’t be wasting his time trying to heal his allies' armor health. It would be more helpful in most scenarios if he just shot the enemy.

minor.title: Pre-Heated
content: no guide provided
perk: Pre-Heated

major.title: Anchor Bolts
content: * Best Major Perk
* High and inconvenient
* * Find places that are way out of the enemy's LoS where they have to look away from your team in order to shoot the Turret.
* Above and behind

* * No enemy is going to be looking above and behind them as they walk through a choke point. Sticking your Turret to the choke point wall won’t shoot the enemy until they come through the choke. But that also means they can’t destroy before walking in.
* New locations
* * When running Anchor Bolts, never just stick your Turret to the floor. Keep changing the location and keep the enemy guessing.

major.title: Overloaded Turret
content: * Decent Major Perk
* Overload damage
* * When Torb activates Overload, and this Major Perk causes the Turret to transform into the Overloaded Turret, there is a notable startup animation before the Turret starts firing again.

* Consequently, you don’t even get the extra damage throughout your whole Overload. So, while this Perk can be helpful because of some extra burst damage, it’s very brief and infrequent due to Overload’s cooldown.
* Instant Turret heal
* * The best part of this perk is really the extra Turret health to keep it alive when it's being attacked. You can Overload, run to Turret with Craftsman, and it becomes very tanky.

minor.title: Assault Burst
content: no guide provided
perk: Assault Burst

minor.title: Expanded Field
content: Makes Barrier Field tosses much more consistent and forgiving. The AoE is huge, so even if your placement isn’t perfect, you have a much higher chance of getting yourself and your teammates within the field.

major.title: Automated Healing
content: * Nice to have for some extra healing. May not feel game-changing because his cooldowns are so long, but the extra 120 can make the difference of life and death for an ally.

major.title: Rocket Boots
content: * Strengthens Bap's biggest weakness
* * With only vertical mobility, Bap struggles against high mobility enemies. He just jumps up and gets destroyed mid-air. With Rocket Boots, he becomes significantly more evasive.
* Also comes in handy when jumping over barriers and walls, as you can mix up your movement and make it less likely to get sniped out of the air.
* The best choice, especially against dive comps.

minor.title: Familiar Vitals
content: _“Pulsar Torpedoes lock onto allies 35% faster.”_
* Save low HP allies

* * The only weakness of ![](/data/assets/guide/d30517a5688f2742.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpulsar-torpedoes.png)Pulsar Torpedoes is the time it takes to lock on, then the slow travel speed of the projectile. Teammates sometimes die before the healing arrives. 35% increase for only healing Torpedoes may not sound like a lot, but in critical moments it means the difference between life and death for ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno's allies.

minor.title: Locked On
content: _“Reduce the cooldown of Pulsar Torpedoes by 1 second for each enemy hit.”_
* Good when able to play more offensively
* * Getting to use her Torpedoes more often puts extra pressure on the enemy team and builds Ult charge faster.
* You need to frequently get at least one or two enemies locked on.

* Don't tunnel vision on only dealing damage, ![](/data/assets/guide/d30517a5688f2742.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpulsar-torpedoes.png)Pulsar Torpedoes are your best source of burst healing for your allies.

major.title: Faster Blaster
content: * Burst value

* * When picking this Perk, you gain ~30% fire rate increase during ![](/data/assets/guide/0af76c2c1400b1cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fglide-boost.png)Glide Boost.
* That gives you the option for both burst damage and burst healing.
* Good for dueling.

major.title: Lift Off
content: * Extra verticality

* * The extra 3rd jump can be use at any time, including during ![](/data/assets/guide/0af76c2c1400b1cb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fglide-boost.png)Glide Boost. This allows ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno to reach new heights and access some high ground that is normally just above her reach.

* Good for hopping above a wall to fire ![](/data/assets/guide/d30517a5688f2742.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpulsar-torpedoes.png)Pulsar Torpedoes, and for escaping from close-range enemies who lack vertical mobility.
* Counter Perk

* * Against melee, and close-range enemies, Lift Off can be the better Major Perk to choose, because it will help ![](/data/assets/guide/13c0663d738c73ee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fjuno.png)Juno keep distance from her attackers.

minor.title: Angelic Resurrection
content: * Considering how impactful Resurrect is, but also how vulnerable ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy becomes during it, the Overhealth can be the difference between a won and lost game.

minor.title: Divine Momentum
content: * Counter dive

* * Against teams that are running dive comps or have people constantly flanking and targeting you, the extra distance ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)Mercy travels by bunny hopping or crouch jumping can be your only means of survival

major.title: Chain Boost
content: * Good in poke and brawl
* * First off, you need two allies to be playing near each other most of the game. Secondly, you want both of those heroes to have kits that benefit from damage boost.
* If your team is running two ranged heroes, Chain Boost is great for increasing their pressure and threat.
* When your team is running a brawl comp, Chain Boost makes their deathball more lethal and helps them run over the enemy more aggressively.

major.title: Flash Heal
content: * Wait for your target to be below half health.
* * Never waste the 15-second cooldown on the base 50 healing. Always wait to get the triple healing on low HP allies.
* More time to damage boost
* * The burst healing cuts down the amount of time you need to spend healing a low-health ally, thus increasing the amount of time you can spend damage boosting.

minor.title: Discordant Repair
content: no guide provided
perk: Discordant Repair

minor.title: Ascendance
content: * New positioning possibilities

* * Instead of just increasing one of ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta's abilities, Ascendance gives him a completely new power that opens up a lot of new playmaking opportunities.
* Hover between high ground

* * Maps with lots of high ground are usually difficult for ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta , but with Ascendance, he can keep the high ground once he has it.

* Example: Numbani opening capture point. Zen can use staircases to get to any of the high ground areas. Afterwards, he uses Ascendance to float between high ground to reposition for either defensive protection or an offensive attack.
* Shoot over walls and barriers
* * Charge up a secondary fire, then double jump above a wall or a barrier and attack from an angle not possible without hover.
* Find new flank spots

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta loves flanking and looking to delete an unsuspecting foe with a fully charged right-click. Many maps have perimeter paths that ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta can only traverse with Ascendance. Be on the lookout and experiment.

major.title: Focused Destruction
content: * Increased offensive threat
* One-shot 300HP heroes

* * Normally, a fully charged volley will kill the standard 250 HP hero. With Focused Destruction, ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta now eliminates all heroes up to 300HP like Mei and Reaper.

* You can spam secondary fire more often because of the faster charge speed, but the same tips and principles apply from ![](/data/assets/guide/a7f6469e50fb0458.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Forb-of-destruction.png)Orb of Destruction (Charge) tips above.

major.title: Dual Harmony
content: * Recommended Major Perk
* The net gain is +40% healing which translates to faster ultimate charging. Moreover, keeping two allies with sustain is a lot stronger than a bit more healing on a single target.

minor.title: Combat Medic
content: * Recommended Minor Perk

* Keep an eye on your ![](/data/assets/guide/8053c37a257e8067.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frepair-pack.png)Repair Pack cooldowns when brawling. Try to not let it sit at 3 packs when you have the opportunity to swing on the enemy so that you can maximize the benefit and extra healing output.
* Good when the team needs extra healing
* * When you see the other Support struggling to keep your allies alive, Combat Medic is the way to go.

minor.title: Morale Boost
content: * Pick when struggling to keep Inspire up.
* Whip Shot and Inspire

* * Inspire lasts four seconds, and ![](/data/assets/guide/7a4683cc8d893758.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwhip-shot.png)Whip Shot is a four-second cooldown. Therefore, if you land two Whip Shots in a row, you won’t even be benefiting from Morale Boost.
* If you find your Inspire uptime is low or are struggling to find consistent opportunities to proc Inspire, Morale Boost can be a good choice.

major.title: Inspiring Strike
content: * Movement
* * Bash movement is one of the most important tools Brig has in her arsenal. Gaining even movement speed buff just makes it that much stronger.
* Increased aggression
* * Brig can be more aggressive with her positiong when using Inspiring Strike because she can dive and rush down enemies faster, and disengage faster as well.
* The instant Inspire healing also makes her tankier in duels.

major.title: Whiplash
content: * Situational, but clutch

* * You won’t be benefiting from wall damage every time you ![](/data/assets/guide/7a4683cc8d893758.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fwhip-shot.png)Whip Shot, but when you do, the extra damage can secure kills or create the pressure needed to win the fight.
* Best on enclosed maps
* * Maps with lots of structures and walls give you more opportunities to line up wall slams.
* Try to strafe and line up enemies with any structure to get more wall slams in each game.
* Unique breakpoints
* * The extra 50 damage creates new “one-shot” combos against 225 and 275 HP heroes:
* 235 damage combo: Flail → Bash → Whip Shot-wall-slam
* 280 damage combo: Flail → Bash → Flail → Whip Shot-wall-slam

minor.title: Steamroller
content: * Not very impactful as an extra 60 damage on Tanks isn’t making a notable difference. Also, Tanks should not be your main target.

minor.title: Multi-Ball
content: * Extra area denial and counterplay to escapes. For example, if you try to slam and drop mines on a ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira but they Fade away, chase them, then drop the additional mines to trap them for a kill.

* Even better when you save ![](/data/assets/guide/e2a04628b040f9a1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgrappling-claw.png)Grappling Claw for after your Ult. Use high ground to roll in instead of swinging so you can immediately chase.

major.title: Hang Time
content: * Good against squishy heroes with poor mobility like ![](/data/assets/guide/d61f1a6f760500a9.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzenyatta.png)Zenyatta or ![](/data/assets/guide/affc69220cbf88d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhanzo.png)Hanzo.

major.title: Adaptive Barrier
content: * Very strong as it gives you direct counterplay against crowd control, such as ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)Roadhog ![](/data/assets/guide/92d64f77a57b16b8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fchain-hook.png)Chain Hook and ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)Ana's ![](/data/assets/guide/89ddbbfe1fbc9a6c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsleep-dart.png)Sleep Dart.

minor.title: Void Surge
content: * Strengthen Ram’s weakness

* * The extra burst damage has more impact than it seems on paper. Also, compared to Prolonged Barrier, ![](/data/assets/guide/18b39bbccad34011.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvoid-barrier-omnic-form.png)Void Barrier (Omnic Form) never breaks, and an extra second will rarely make a game-changing difference.

* Better damage in Omnic Form allows Ram to be more of a threat while waiting for ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form.

minor.title: Relentless Form
content: * Most of Ram's value is generated while in ![](/data/assets/guide/058cc46b9e18740c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fnemesis-form.png)Nemesis Form. Being able to extend the duration is really good. You won't always be able to get an elimination, but when you do, this is a very impactful buff.

major.title: Nanite Repair
content: * Bit of extra sustain
* * When inside Vortex for the full duration, Ram will heal for 150 health.

* Helpful when brawling because you can throw Vortex at your feet, and stay inside while Pummeling the enemy ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)Tank.

major.title: Vengeful Vortex
content: * Better for poke
* * Being able to detonate Vortex in the air makes it easy to catch distant enemies without needing to hit a perfect placement. The 50 detonation damage also helps increase your poke lethality.
* Better rush downs
* * When chasing down an enemy, shoot Vortex in front of them and detonate to force them to walk through. This makes rushing down targets notably easier.

minor.title: Drift Thrusters
content: * Pretty much the only way you can expect to survive using your own ult. While the movement may not look like much, this perk has proven very effective at making Barrage more successful.

minor.title: Helix Shields
content: * Good self-sustain. Best when you are not able to get consistent healing from your Supports.

major.title: Fuel Stores
content: * Allows Pharah to stay in the sky for longer. Best on maps with lots of vertical cover like Watchpoint Gibraltar.

major.title: Rocket Salvo
content: * Considering Pharah has two movement abilities, you get to activate the mini-rockets pretty often. Good for extra damage and better AoE.
* New total on direct hit is 200

minor.title: Encrypted Upload
content: * Extra sneaky
* * Use the extra stealth to Hack an enemy, then reposition when they try and turn to attack you. Only commit to revealing yourself with your attack once they're disoriented trying to find you.
* Infinite Invisibility

* * Encrypted Upload increases stealth’s duration to 7 seconds and Translocator is on a 6-second cooldown. So technically, Sombra can Hack and Translocate repeatedly without ever becoming unstealthed.
* Good for Hacking health packs because you make up for lost time with the increased uptime.

minor.title: CTRL ALT ESC
content: * Situational

* * Most of the time, you are engaging with Translocator, so you already have full health, or you’re getting away from the enemy so you’re not in danger of dying. Therefore, you won’t need the self-healing too often.
* Moreover, you can just wait for the universal healing passive to kick in for a similar effect.
* Does decrease down time between engages.

major.title: High-Speed Bandwidth
content: * Decent when paired with flankers who frequently use health packs like ![](/data/assets/guide/5c24a105db5a970e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Ftracer.png)Tracer and ![](/data/assets/guide/2d37d713fbda6bee.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwrecking-ball.png)Wrecking Ball.
* Come in clutch in the niche situation of dueling near a health pack.
* Often people grab health packs out of combat, so the impact is low.

major.title: Viral Replication
content: * More ult charge
* * Although not as free or consistent, you can deal high amounts of AoE damage through Viral Replication, which also results in faster EMPs.
* Especially good against closely grouped team comps like brawl comps.
* More lethal ultimates

* * As you'll often be hitting a group of enemies with ![](/data/assets/guide/7fac3c200ab1ed09.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Femp.png)EMP, the follow-up ![](/data/assets/guide/193bfabc2fb3df0f.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fvirus.png)Virus is helpful to your team for converting more elims.

minor.title: Destruction's Divide
content: * Good for optimizing her Ult’s purpose. Especially if you like to dive in and use ![](/data/assets/guide/c2024d883333803a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoalescence.png)Coalescenceoffensively.

minor.title: Ethical Nourishment
content: * Amazing for giving ![](/data/assets/guide/d2383fba0420b5f1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmoira.png)Moira burst healing. Much more consistent value than Destruction’s Divide.

major.title: Reversal
content: * Gives you control over orbs. Use this to keep enemies attached and damage, or give your allies healing for longer.

major.title: Phantom Step
content: * Good mobility. Best against dive comps to give you better escapes.
* Also enables more aggressive dive playtsyle for yourself since you have better access to high ground areas.

minor.title: Petal Protection
content: * A bit of extra Sustain, and ult charge.

* ![](/data/assets/guide/41367de8021167d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver can use the healing himself, which is especially good when petal dancing to avoid an attacker.

minor.title: Dashing Escape
content: * Survive dive

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/41367de8021167d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver needs all the survivability he can get against dive attacks, and the extra distance from this perk can make the difference between life and death against close-range dive enemies like ![](/data/assets/guide/52c34367e459b0af.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fvendetta.png)Vendetta.
* Keep up with mobile teams

* * Also good to selecte when your team consists of highly mobile heroes like ![](/data/assets/guide/2e4a51913793e6dc.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fd-va.png)D.Va or ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)Winston.

major.title: Superbloom
content: * The math

* * In 2.5 seconds, ![](/data/assets/guide/41367de8021167d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver will fire 55 thorns, and you need to land 16 of those to trigger the detonation.
* You miss ~1/3 of your shots and still trigger Superbloom.
* Self defense

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/41367de8021167d5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Flifeweaver.png)Lifeweaver's attack pressure is pretty low, and the extra incremental burst damage is useful when forced into duels.
* Anti-tank
* * Especially against non-barrier Tanks who can’t block your attacks, you can pump Thorn Volleys into their large bodies and trigger Superbloom detonations over and over.
* Pair with another high healing output Support
* * When you want to focus more on damage, play with another high-healing Support. If your other Support is Zen, for example, your team can’t afford for you to be spending time triggering Superbloom.

major.title: Sow the Seed
content: * Best for rush and brawl allies, as they get a lot of milage from movement buff and a burst of overhealth.
* Throw the seed in front of where your teammate is going, so they can pick it up as they chase the enemy.
